Main duties will centre around the yachts, the customers, and the base. Working hours vary and you MUST be able to cover operational requirements including early and evening shifts as required. The weekend are the busiest days at base and will be working days, days off will be scheduled mid-week.
Our exterior yacht cleaning teams play a vital role in our business. You will be a key driver in providing that “wow” factor when customers first step on board their vessel. It will be your responsibility to deliver superior cleaning excellence to ensure the outside of our yachts meet the standard that give our guests that exceptional first impression.
What You Will Be Doing
Carrying out a full clean of the yacht from the bridge deck to engine bays, including a rinse, soap wash, and chamois, followed by detailing of the yacht.
Ensuring the yachts are presentable to the highest standards set by the company, which will include;
Scrubbing the exterir of the yachts daily
Cleaning f shower curtains, rails, external cushions, and bilges.
Cleaning and detailing f all lockers (gas, anchor and water locker), cleaning inside and all rims and outside edges.
Cleaning and detailing f the helm station including winch handle pockets, cup holders and dorades
Buffing f the yachts
Cleaning all rubbing strakes and make sure all exhaust utlets are spotless
Reporting any defects noticed whilst cleaning to the technical manager
Utilizing chemicals in a safe and cost-effective way
Suggesting improvements for cleaning techniques
Any other reasonable duties as assigned by your line manager, including supporting with other departments, and cleaning of other areas.

Experience in a cleaning position is desirable
Comfortable moving around yachts confidently
A desire for excellence
Superior attention to detail
Self-motivated and able to show initiative
Takes pride in their work, and desire to excel in delivering yacht cleanliness to the highest standards
Able to work under pressure to deadlines
A team player that will assist others when required
A hard worker, who is reliable and professional
Dedicated to our guests and the guests experience
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
We believe people perform best when they can be their true selves, and diverse teams drive better results. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where everyone can succeed.

Major duties include: Executes a full range of housekeeping activities in patient and non-patient care areas. Performs floor maintenance, wall washing. Cleans doors, doorframes, baseboard corners and edges, and stairwells. Periodically utilizes pressure washers and heavy industrial powered and battery operated equipment.

Adjusts, cleans, and performs minor maintenance on this equipment and changes attachments for their proper use in achieving the best results. Empties trash and wastebaskets, replaces liners. Transports general refuse, regulated medical waste and recycling to central collection areas.

Cleans rest rooms, bathrooms, and shower rooms, ensuring that they are cleaned and meet acceptable standards (cleans, disinfects, and deodorizes lavatories, showers, bathtubs, urinals, and toilet bowls; cleans mirrors, sinks, and water fountains; washes and polishes light and toilet fixtures).

Replenishes supplies of paper towels, toilet paper, hand sanitizers, and soap in all areas where dispensers are located. Moves and arranges furniture, patient wardrobes, beds, etc. in the assigned area to accomplish cleaning tasks.

Provides bed-making services in patient care areas and OD rooms; cleans mattresses, springs, and bed frames; and cleans bedside stands, over bed lights, blood pressure cuffs, bed tables, etc. in patient rooms; Removes bags of soiled textiles from patient rooms and transports to the designated soiled room in each ward area; Loads and unloads clean textiles from bulk carts.

Restocks clean textile closets, cabinets, shelves, carts, and participates in inventory management activities.

Defrosts and cleans patient care refrigerators and ice machines in nourishment kitchen areas; cleans stainless steel on storage instrument cabinets and counters, elevators in lobbies, wards, diet-kitchens and nurse utility rooms; and cleans ashtrays, smoke stands, sand urns in designated smoke areas and water fountains.

Provides interim cleaning of windows and window ledges from the inside, cleans glass door and other glass surfaces; and replaces curtains and cleans blinds. Cleans and/or replaces needle boxes. Periodically cleans specific non-critical Reusable Medical Equipment (RME) in inpatient and clinical areas of the medical center.

May work with and provide guidance to a Compensated Work Therapy (CWT) worker. Perform other duties as assigned.

Work Schedule: Full-Time work schedules available: 7:00am - 3:30pm Wednesday-Sunday (Mon/Tues off) rotating federal holidays and 3:30pm - 12:00am Monday-Friday (Sat/Sun off) rotating federal holidays (work hours may be further discussed during the interview).

Evidence which demonstrates you possess the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of this position must be supported by detailed descriptions of such on your resume. Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Federal Wage System Qualification Standards.

SCREEN-OUT ELEMENT: Your qualifications will first be evaluated against the prescribed screen out element, which usually appears as question 1 in the on-line questionnaire.

Those applicants who appear to possess at least the minimal acceptable qualification requirement are considered for further rating; those who do not are rated ineligible and are eliminated.

The potential eligibles are then rated against the remainder of the Job Elements: Dexterity and Safety Follow Directions Handle Weights and Loads Reliability And Dependability Special Aptitude - Housekeeping Work Work Practices Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Note: A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week.

Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities. Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

Physical Requirements: You will be asked to participate in a pre-employment evaluation as part of the pre-employment process for this position. Questions about physical demands or environmental factors may be addressed at the time of evaluation or examination.

The position demands continuous walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, pulling, and pushing. The work requires the occasional use of heavy powered cleaning equipment (e.g., wall washers, industrial type buffers) weighing over 50 pounds.

The duties necessitate considerable dexterity, hand, foot, and eye coordination, and concentration as well as visual acuity to see dirt, dust, and debris. Work Environment: Work is normally performed indoors with adequate heat, light, and ventilation.

Some work may be performed outdoors where there may be exposed to varying degrees of heat and cold as well as inclement weather. PPE may be required in some circumstance as exposure to possible contagious diseases, blood, and bloody secretion are inherent to this position.

Care is required to avoid serious injuries (i.e. broken bones) when working on ladders, or when using 30-100 pound power equipment or handling hazardous materials.

ELS is hiring for the position of Housekeeper in Weslaco, Texas. What you'll do: Our housekeepers make sure that our resorts are clean and tidy to ensure that our guests have a five-star experience.

Your job will include: Housekeepers clean the resort office, clubhouse, public access areas and models as directed, including mopping, dusting, vacuuming and removing trash. Housekeepers also clean cabins and rentals to prepare for new guests. Keep rentals and common areas clean and maintain them to our standards.

Keep track of cleaning supply inventory and request refills as needed. Report any maintenance concerns for repairs in common areas, vacant or rental homes to the Resort Manager or Maintenance Supervisor. As a housekeeper you will also assist the maintenance staff and other staff members as needed.

Assist with cleaning up resort-sponsored guest activities and functions. Assist your Resort Manager in responding to guest inquiries in a timely, professional manner and with patience and concern. Solve guest-related problems and address conflicts with a positive attitude.

Housekeepers may also drive a motorized vehicle to run errands and/or pick up supplies as needed. Work closely with management and the management staff to maintain open communications and make sure that the resort team is integrated and coordinated. Provide outstanding customer service.

Experience & skills you need: High school diploma or the equivalent. One to three years of experience in a housekeeping role. Knowledge of cleaning supplies and products. Previous housekeeping experience is a plus. Organizational skills and attention to details. Valid driver's license, good driving record and current auto insurance.

Ability to lift up to 50 pounds. Willing and able to work weekends and holidays as needed. In return for your excellent skills and abilities, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental, and vision plans, a generous 401(k) employer match, and paid vacations, holidays, and sick time.

We invite you to visit our web site at www.equitylifestyleproperties.com for additional information regarding our exceptional resort communities. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and thank all applicants.

Are you passionate about hospitality, quality, and creating an outstanding guest experience? Do you enjoy being hands\-on, building and coordinating teams, and making sure every apartment is perfectly prepared for our guests? Then this could be the right opportunity for you.

As Housekeeping Supervisor, you will take ownership of the housekeeping operations at one of our City Pop locations in Zurich.
This is a hands\-on leadership role combining team management, quality control, planning, inventory management, and daily operations.
You will help set up and manage our in\-house housekeeping team, from recruiting and onboarding staff to organizing schedules, equipment, supplies, and cleaning standards.
You will also work alongside the team when needed, particularly during busy periods and operational peaks.
Your goal is to build a reliable and efficient housekeeping operation that ensures consistent quality and an excellent guest experience.

Actively perform cleaning duties as part of the housekeeping team. This is a hands\-on role, and you will be regularly involved in cleaning apartments and common areas alongside your team, not only during staff shortages or peak periods.
Take ownership of the setup and daily organization of the housekeeping operation across our City Pop buildings.
Manage the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of the cleaning team, in coordination with HR, ensuring all employees are trained according to City Pop standards and procedures.
Prepare and manage the weekly cleaning schedules, considering occupancy, arrivals and departures, holidays, sick leave, and operational needs.
Act as the main point of contact for the cleaning team, supporting them with daily questions, operational issues, and priorities.
Ensure apartments and common areas are cleaned, inspected, and ready on time, carrying out regular quality controls and following up on any issues until resolution.
Set up and manage the housekeeping inventory, including the purchase of cleaning equipment and materials such as tools, chemicals, cloths, trolleys, and other required supplies.
Manage and replenish guest supplies handled by Housekeeping, including toilet paper, soaps, coffee, tea, and other amenities, ensuring sufficient stock is always available and properly organized on\-site.
Manage housekeeping supplies and purchases within the agreed budget, monitoring stock levels, consumption, and costs.
Organize deep cleanings, special cleanings, and apartment preparations, and ensure correct management of Lost \& Found.
Report technical defects or damages and coordinate with Operations, Facility Management, technicians, and other departments to ensure timely resolution.
Continuously review housekeeping processes and team performance, implementing improvements to increase quality, efficiency, and guest satisfaction.

At least 3 years of professional housekeeping experience, ideally in hotels, serviced apartments, or the hospitality industry.
Previous experience in a Housekeeping Supervisor or similar role is a strong advantage.
Experience in leading, training, and coordinating cleaning teams.
Strong knowledge of housekeeping standards, quality control, inventory, and daily cleaning operations.
A strong hands\-on mentality, with the willingness to work alongside the team when required.
Well organized, proactive, solution\-oriented, and able to manage priorities independently.
Strong attention to detail and excellent guest and service orientation.
Minimum B2 level in both German and English; additional languages are an advantage.
Comfortable using digital tools and operational systems.
Reliable, flexible, and stress\-resistant, with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.

-Deep Industry Experience: You bring robust experience in housekeeping management, ideally within the cruise line industry or upscale hospitality sector. You are fully at ease with the dynamic environment and high expectations of a shipboard operation.
-Advanced Leadership Skills: You have proven success in supervising large, multicultural teams and working in partnership with senior officers. Your leadership style inspires performance, motivates excellence, and fosters collaboration across departments.
-Operational Mastery: You are highly skilled in executing and overseeing housekeeping protocols, from sanitation and cleanliness to inventory and supply chain coordination. You know how to anticipate challenges and solve them efficiently.
-Guest-Centric Vision: Your professional journey reflects an unwavering dedication to guest satisfaction. You understand how every detail of a clean, organized environment contributes to a memorable cruise experience.
### **Your Essentials** ###

La femme / le valet de chambre assure le nettoyage, la remise en ordre et l’entretien des chambres et des espaces communs de l’hôtel. Elle/il veille à offrir aux clients un environnement **propre, confortable et accueillant**, dans le respect des standards de qualité, d’hygiène et de service de l’établissement.
## Responsabilités et tâches principales
### Entretien des chambres
* Nettoyer et remettre en ordre les chambres en recouche et en départ.
* Faire les lits et remplacer le linge selon les procédures de l’hôtel.
* Nettoyer et désinfecter les salles de bains et sanitaires.
* Dépoussiérer et nettoyer le mobilier et les différents équipements.
* Aspirer et laver les sols.
* Vider les poubelles et assurer le tri des déchets.
* Réapprovisionner les produits d’accueil et consommables.
* Vérifier la présentation générale de la chambre avant de la libérer.
* Respecter les demandes particulières des clients communiquées par la réception ou la responsable.
### Contrôle des chambres
* Vérifier le bon fonctionnement des équipements : éclairage, télévision, chauffage, sanitaires, sèche-cheveux, etc.
* Signaler immédiatement toute panne, dégradation ou anomalie.
* Signaler les objets oubliés par les clients et respecter la procédure relative aux objets trouvés.
* Informer la responsable de toute situation inhabituelle constatée dans une chambre.
### Espaces communs
* Participer au nettoyage et à l'entretien des espaces communs selon les besoins : couloirs, escaliers, ascenseur, réception, sanitaires publics et autres espaces réservés aux clients.
* Veiller en permanence à la propreté et à la bonne présentation des espaces de l'hôtel.
### Linge et matériel
* Préparer le linge et le matériel nécessaires à la journée.
* Assurer une utilisation correcte des produits et équipements de nettoyage.
* Respecter les dosages et les consignes d'utilisation des produits.
* Participer à la gestion et au rangement du linge propre et sale.
* Maintenir les locaux de stockage et le matériel de travail propres et ordonnés.
* Signaler les besoins en produits, matériel ou linge.
## Relation avec la clientèle
* Adopter en permanence une attitude **aimable, discrète et professionnelle**.
* Saluer les clients rencontrés dans l'établissement.
* Répondre avec courtoisie aux demandes simples des clients et transmettre les autres demandes à la réception.
* Respecter strictement la vie privée et les effets personnels des clients.
* Faire preuve de discrétion concernant toute information obtenue dans le cadre du travail.
## Hygiène et sécurité
* Respecter les procédures d'hygiène et de nettoyage de l'établissement.
* Respecter les règles de sécurité liées à l'utilisation des produits et du matériel.
* Utiliser les équipements de protection lorsque cela est nécessaire.
* Signaler immédiatement tout risque ou problème pouvant affecter la sécurité des clients ou des collaborateurs.
* Respecter les procédures internes en cas d'incident ou d'urgence.
## Profil recherché
* Une première expérience en housekeeping ou dans l'hôtellerie constitue un avantage.
* Sens de la propreté et du détail.
* Rapidité et efficacité dans l'exécution des tâches.
* Bonne organisation et capacité à travailler de manière autonome.
* Bonne condition physique.
* Ponctualité et fiabilité.
* Esprit d'équipe et entraide.
* Présentation soignée et comportement professionnel.
* Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité.
* Flexibilité concernant les horaires de travail, notamment les week-ends et jours fériés.
## Compétences attendues

s.h: La personne occupant ce poste doit notamment faire preuve de
s.t:
* **Rigueur** – respecter les standards de nettoyage de l'hôtel.
* **Efficacité** – organiser son travail afin de respecter le planning des chambres.
* **Sens du détail** – repérer les éléments qui peuvent affecter la qualité du séjour.
* **Fiabilité** – respecter les horaires, les procédures et les responsabilités confiées.
* **Esprit d'équipe** – collaborer efficacement avec le housekeeping, la réception et les autres départements.
* **Orientation client** – contribuer par son travail à la satisfaction et au confort des clients.
## Organisation du travail
Les horaires sont établis en fonction de l'occupation et des besoins de l'hôtel. Le travail peut comprendre les **week-ends et jours fériés**.
La femme / le valet de chambre travaille en coordination étroite avec la réception afin de garantir la disponibilité des chambres dans les délais prévus pour les arrivées.
## Objectif du poste
Garantir quotidiennement un **niveau irréprochable de propreté, d'ordre et de présentation des chambres et des espaces confiés**, afin de contribuer directement à la qualité du séjour et à la satisfaction des clients de l'hôtel.

Incumbent functions as the Environmental Care Specialist with responsibilities for housekeeping activities within the Environmental Management Service.

This involves all aspects of environmental sanitation, within acceptable levels of bacteriological and visual cleanliness effective in this geographical location, and fully coordinated with other activities in this active affiliated teaching Medical Center.

The incumbent directs and supervises the Housekeeping Section, fully coordinating activities with other services and staff to ensure required services are provided with absolute minimum of disruption. Directly supervises the Assistant Chief, supervisors (7) WS Housekeeping Foreman.

Incumbent is responsible for the preventative control through supervision of the housekeeping section, to include planning, organizing, directing, controlling and evaluating the service provided by Housekeeping staff. Position requires travel to the offsite clinics and other visits to end users.

Incumbent will be driving a motor vehicle when visiting sites up to a maximum of 120 miles, one way. Incumbent is responsible for managing the facility wide Recycling Program. Identifies all products that can be profitable recycled and formulates procedures to be followed.

Responsibility includes maintaining an accounting procedure to track the number of products being collected for recycling and the amount earned because of these efforts.

As a supervisor, the incumbent is responsible for the active support within the service of the Medical Center's EEO Program, seeking to eliminate barriers to EEO: ensuring development opportunities for qualified employees, ensuring lines of communication are open to all employees on an equal basis and affirmative action activities.

This responsibility especially extends to implementation of the Medial Center's EEO Plan of Action as it applies. The incumbent must exercise broad managerial knowledge and technical expertise within the various disciplines of the Service. The incumbent will also make recommendations and manage space allocations.

An effective and efficient EMS program must fully coordinate their activities with every organizational element in the Medical Center. Performs analytical and evaluative work associated with service line and program activities.

Develops, analyzes, evaluates, advises on, or improves the effectiveness of work methods and procedures, organizations, manpower utilization, distribution of work assignments, delegations of authority, management controls, information and documentation systems, and similar functions of management.

Administers operating programs and activities supporting environmental sanitation, textile services, waste management and pest management in support of services provided to veterans, their dependents or beneficiaries.

Analyzes and evaluates, on a quantitative or qualitative basis, the effectiveness of programs or operations in meeting established goals and objectives. Evaluates agency­ wide programs against short and long-range objectives.

Performs administrative work in personnel management and administration, budgeting and financial management, procurement and contracting, property management, and/or supply. Directs the personnel management program for the organization, performing, or overseeing the full range of human resources requirements.

Maintains continuous liaison with the departmental human resources office in areas of personnel recruiting, promotion, training, equal opportunity employment, disciplinary action, performance evaluation, etc. Is responsible for managing the personnel costs to insure maximum utilization of personnel and funding resources.

The incumbent analyzes the broad implications of laws, regulations, policies, as well as managerial, administrative, and technical trends. Local EMS policies further expand management considerations involving general administration practices, budgeting, utilization of manpower and other resources.

Coordinates and controls housekeeping program operations. Provides advisory services to service chiefs, supervisors, and staff of other services and to management officials, when . directed, regarding the requirements and resolution of substantive housekeeping problem and services.
